title: Pre-commit lint target omitted tree_police verification suite
summary: The Makefile lint target only invoked zqk-vet --suite hygiene, allowing unapproved migration and setup scripts placed directly in scripts/ to evade pre-commit gates.
recommendation: Update Makefile lint target to execute zqk-vet --suite hygiene,tree to ensure that unapproved script placement in release candidate trees is caught before commit time.
non_goals: Do not remove standard release-packaging scripts.

evidence.detail: zqk-vet --suite tree flagged 14 extra unapproved scripts in scripts/ prior to relocation into scripts/open-core/setup_scripts/.

verification_proof: Makefile: lint and vet targets run bin/zqk-vet with tree_police pass (0 errors, 0 warnings)

title: Lifecycle specification for qa_success omitted status default completion mapping
summary: The qa_success_lifecycle.yaml spec omitted the percent_complete.default_by_status map, preventing the CLI promotion state machine from recognizing forward progress from conceptual to originated.
recommendation: Maintain explicit status_defaults in all lifecycle specs across the platform to ensure fail-closed state machines permit valid membrane crossings.
non_goals: Do not allow unvalidated direct status overrides.

evidence.detail: Added default_by_status mapping for conceptual, originated, success, failure, archived.

citations.source: ZQK Lifecycle State Machine Specification Contract

verification_proof: .zqk/specs/lifecycles/qa/qa_success_lifecycle.yaml default_by_status verified active across CAS membrane

title: AuditorGate falls back to unencrypted disk keystore when CAS entry is absent
summary: In AuditorGate.trustedPubHex, when the key object KEY-AUDITOR-001 is missing from CAS, the system falls back to loading .zqk/keystore/auditor.priv from the local disk filesystem without hardware security module or keychain binding.
recommendation: Introduce an explicit production mode configuration that disallows disk-based private key fallback for cryptographic sign-off in enterprise environments.
non_goals: Do not break developer workstation local workflow.

citations.source: OWASP ASVS Level 2 Cryptographic Key Management

title: IsInTest heuristic incorrectly flags go run binaries compiling into go-build directories
summary: The test isolation heuristic in zqkenv.IsInTest inspects os.Args[0] for 'go-build', causing standalone utility scripts executed via go run to trigger guardRepoMutation panics.
recommendation: Rely primarily on flag.Lookup('test.v') and process lineage rather than fragile binary path substring checks when detecting test environments.
non_goals: Do not disable repo write protection during actual automated test suite runs.

evidence.detail: strings.Contains(os.Args[0], 'go-build') flags go run invocations outside of testing.T.

citations.source: Go standard library testing package conventions
